title: Llama reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- llama body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='70' rx='26' ry='18' fill='#f6d7a8'/>
  <!-- belly patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='16' ry='11' fill='#ffe9c4'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='31' y='80' width='9' height='16' rx='4' fill='#e8bf85'/>
  <rect x='58' y='80' width='9' height='16' rx='4' fill='#e8bf85'/>
  <!-- hooves -->
  <rect x='31' y='92' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b98a5a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='92' width='9' height='5' rx='2' fill='#b98a5a'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <rect x='44' y='28' width='16' height='34' rx='8' fill='#f6d7a8'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='52' cy='24' rx='16' ry='14' fill='#f6d7a8'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='30' rx='10' ry='7' fill='#ffe9c4'/>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='15' rx='4' ry='10' fill='#f6d7a8' transform='rotate(-15 38 15)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='17' rx='2' ry='6' fill='#f2b8a2' transform='rotate(-15 38 17)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='14' rx='4' ry='10' fill='#f6d7a8' transform='rotate(15 64 14)'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='16' rx='2' ry='6' fill='#f2b8a2' transform='rotate(15 64 16)'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='22' r='2.6' fill='#5b3a1e'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='22' r='2.6' fill='#5b3a1e'/>
  <circle cx='46.8' cy='21.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='58.8' cy='21.2' r='0.9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- nose and mouth -->
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='29' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#b98a5a'/>
  <path d='M56 33 Q59 35 62 33' stroke='#b98a5a' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- front legs resting on book -->
  <rect x='35' y='64' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#f6d7a8' transform='rotate(10 39 74)'/>
  <rect x='54' y='64' width='8' height='20' rx='4' fill='#f6d7a8' transform='rotate(-10 58 74)'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 50 84)'>
    <rect x='28' y='74' width='44' height='18' rx='3' fill='#d94f4f'/>
    <rect x='28' y='74' width='44' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ef7070'/>
    <rect x='30' y='78' width='18' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#fff4d6'/>
    <rect x='52' y='78' width='18' height='12' rx='1.5' fill='#fff4d6'/>
    <line x1='50' y1='76' x2='50' y2='90' stroke='#b83a3a' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='34' y1='82' x2='45' y2='82' stroke='#c9a86a' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='34' y1='85' x2='43' y2='85' stroke='#c9a86a' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='55' y1='82' x2='66' y2='82' stroke='#c9a86a' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
    <line x1='55' y1='85' x2='64' y2='85' stroke='#c9a86a' stroke-width='1.3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  </g>
  <!-- blush -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='27' r='2.5' fill='#f2a0a0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='63' cy='26' r='2.5' fill='#f2a0a0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- little heart -->
  <path d='M78 40 C78 37 74 36 74 39 C74 36 70 37 70 40 C70 44 74 46 74 48 C74 46 78 44 78 40 Z' fill='#ff7aa8'/>
</svg>
